i.norm: Verifies that content appended directly to a Document (as siblings of the root <html> element) is serialized after the closing </html> tag. Both {@code append()} and {@code appendText()} place nodes outside the normal html/head/body structure, so they appear as "brbr" after "</html>" in output.
append() parses "br" as an HTML fragment and attaches it as a sibling of <html>
appendText() attaches a plain text node as another sibling of <html>
